Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this treatment, they make a real difference every day in the lives of patients with cancer and other serious diseases.

The company is growing fast and is looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

At Legend Biotech, as a Quality Control Support, you’ll have the chance to make a real difference.Your work will directly contribute to improving the lives of sick patients around the world.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• You assist with daily quality analyses and help ensure reliable test results.	
• You check, clean, and disinfect equipment, and manage lab materials and waste.	
• ou ensure safe and accurate sample transfers between departments.	
• You assist with various analyses in the labs.	
• You accurately log all your tasks in logs, forms, or the quality system.

	
• You have experience in Quality, preferably.	
• You live nearby Ghent and can easily commute to work, even without public transportation.	
• You speak English well.	
• You have a clean and accurate working style.	
• You collaborate well with others.	
• You are comfortable working with a laptop and MS-Office.	
• You are flexible and able to work in shifts.

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

• Leverage Azure services for cloud-native, scalable, and secure solutions

• Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps best practices

Very good knowledge in the following technologies is a plus

• C#

• Problem-solving

• Rigorous methodology

Qualifications

• 5+ years in .NET / .NET Core development

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus

• English + French and / or Dutch

For our client in Heverlee, we are looking for a new Business Analyst. Do you already have valuable professional experience and are you looking for a new challenge? Then be sure to read on!

Here’s a glimpse of your responsibilities:

• Project Management – Manage the portfolio of ESO IT and business transformation projects, covering prioritisation, planning, stakeholder alignment, risk management, budgeting and successful delivery
• Process Analysis – Identify opportunities for process standardisation, automation and digitalisation to enable scalable business growth
• Requirements Gathering – Develop functional requirements and specifications by translating the commercial and technical needs of business programmes
• Solution Design – Act as the business representative towards IT and Business Systems teams, ensuring solutions meet both current and future business requirements
• Commercial Management – Drive commercial initiatives including supplier management, contract negotiations, pricing and programme tracking
• Business Liaison – Serve as the key day-to-day link between ESO and operational IT and Business Systems teams
• After-Sales Operations – Support commercial and operational after-sales objectives by identifying and implementing opportunities for operational improvement

• Project management: Proven ability to manage projects and programmes and deliver measurable results
• Analytical mindset: Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights
• Commercial awareness: Able to assess business impact and develop clear, well-founded business cases
• Business analysis: Skilled at translating business needs into clear requirements and specifications for technical teams
• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels
• Collaboration: Strong relationship-building and influencing skills across different departments
• Adaptability: Comfortable managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines
• IT collaboration: Experience working with Business Systems or IT teams
• Languages: Fluent in business English; additional languages are an advantage
• Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

For our client located in Ostend, we are looking for a High Voltage Technician. This company specializes in large, high-quality projects in West and East Flanders.

You job as a HIGH VOLTAGE ELECTRICIAN in OOSTENDE:

  • Maintenance and repair of high-voltage installations;
  • Identifying and resolving malfunctions;
  • Correct administrative processing of interventions;
  • Performing inspections and troubleshooting;
  • Testing and commissioning electrical systems;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams for innovative solutions.
Our client in Ostend is looking for a new High Voltage Technician with the following qualities:

  • Technical background with experience in medium/high-voltage installations or a strong interest in the field;
  • BA5 certification and strong awareness of safety regulations;
  • You speak DUTCH or GOOD ENGLISH;
  • Eager to learn and motivated to grow into an independent role.

For our client located in WESTENDE we are looking for a ROAD WORKER!

Our client is a well-known contractor who does assignments for the government and private sector.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and work outdoors? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE this is your job:

  • You are responsible for sewerage works;
  • You are responsible for placing embroidery;
  • Construction of cycle paths, roads and car parks;
  • Placing environmental pavements;
  • Placing roundabouts and refuges;
  • Placing vowels and paving stones;

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE you can find yourself in the following

  • You speak Englisch or Dutch
  • You are handy and like to work outside
  • No study requirements - motivation is what we need!

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and love renovating? We've got you covered!

Your day as a RENOVATION WORKER in the Veurne region will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you carry out demolition work;
  • You lay ceramic and natural stone tiles;
  • You ensure that masonry and cementing work is carried out correctly;
  • You make sure that stability work is not overlooked;
  • You ensure that the entire renovation is completed with high quality.



As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you meet the following requirements:

  • A telehandler certificate is a plus!
  • You have extensive experience as a renovation worker;
  • You have a category B driving license and can easily commute to the company;
  • You speak Dutch or English

For a family-owned company located in Oudenburg, we are looking for a WORKSHOP CARPENTER.

Do you enjoy making and installing windows? We got you!

As a WINDOW INSTALLER in the Oudenburg region, your tasks will include:

  • Manufacturing and installing wooden balustrades and windows;
  • Reading technical plans and measuring the correct dimensions on wooden structures;
  • Operating CNC machines and specific woodworking machines;
  • Producing window frames;
  • Responsible for the installation of carpentry work;
  • Making and installing custom-made windows and doors (aluminium, PVC, wood, etc.).
As a WINDOW INSTALLER in Oudenburg, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have experience as a carpenter;
  • You speak Dutch or English
  • Physical work does not scare you!

Our client is a family-owned construction company with 30 years of experience. They specialize in new builds and structural work for apartments and houses, mainly for real estate agencies and larger projects.

Your tasks as a BRICKLAYER in KOEKELARE:

This is you as a BRICKLAYER in KOEKELARE:

  • Good command of Dutch or English;
  • Driving license B is a plus, but not required if you can get to the site independently;
  • Enjoy working in a team and have a strong work ethic.
